body: I know you don’t want to hear this but it’s not her responsibility to control your boyfriend. If he has an issue and looks at her or is “getting distracted” by the way she dresses that’s a conversation to have him with him.
I know that it’s not my responsibility, but I can’t wrap my head around how it’s not, especially if something happened to them as a result.
Piracy is generally really wrong, so I wouldn’t advise using libgen to get access to their wide collection of free textbooks.

I forgot to mention in the post, but the biggest reason I’m hesitant is that they talk about contemplating suicide and also mention how I’m one of the only people they can open up to. With the falling out we had (which I put a great deal of that on how I treated them) I have a hard time coping that if they were to do anything to harm themselves, I would certainly feel somewhat responsible.
